title: His mother the pianist and her daily practice
summary: His mother practiced the same pieces daily for a concert that never came, and he could tell lunch by the music; his father liked music but was not musical.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: My mother was a pianist, right. She was always preparing for a concert that never happened. She really didn't intend to have a concert, but she trained as if she would have. She practiced faithfully everyday, she would practice the same music on each day and we would have the same food--this is funny, because when I'd come home from school and I'd hear my mother practicing, I would know what I was going to have for lunch, according to what she was playing.
That lead to a well ordered life.
Well, reasonably ordered at that time.
Is that the piano she was playing then?
No, she had another-- let me think--this may well be that piano, and then again I don't know.
There may have been a change of
pianos when I was going to public school.
Was your father musical in any way?
No, he was an enjoyer, he wasn't musical. But he had good taste, surprisingly. I don't know why.
